fieldOrder.label: Order of the delivery fields
fieldOrder.help: Name, phone and address in the order the customer fills them in. A field left out is added at the end.

enabled.label: Show "Try it on in front of the rider"
enabled.help: A line under the delivery promise. Switch it on only when your riders really wait while the customer tries the item.

enabled.label: Show "Need help? WhatsApp us" on the checkout
enabled.help: A line at the top of the checkout and a box under the summary on a computer. It shows only when the shop's WhatsApp number is set.
